name: List Modules (SA)
help: List loaded modules (DLLs) for a process with version info
long_help: Enumerates all loaded modules (DLLs) for a specified process, displaying file path, company name, and file description from version info. Useful for identifying injected DLLs from EDR/AV products.

arguments.name: pid
arguments.desc: Process ID to inspect. Default: current process (0 or empty)
